user.title: Connect to your FRITZ!Box
user.description: Enter the FRITZ!Box host and a user with telephony permissions. Enable the call monitor first by dialing #96*5* from a phone connected directly to the FRITZ!Box. TR-064 must also be enabled in the FRITZ!Box network settings.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to TR-064 on TCP port 49000. Enable app access in the FRITZ!Box network settings and check the address.
error.call_monitor_unavailable: The call monitor is not reachable on TCP port 1012. Enable it by dialing #96*5* from a phone connected directly to the FRITZ!Box.
error.invalid_auth: The username or password was rejected.
error.insufficient_permissions: This FRITZ!Box user does not have permission to access the phonebook.
